purpose: Explain the shared TCP tracking cost in the active coupled QP.

notation.U_a: stacked arm setpoint-rate commands, not measured joint velocities
notation.epsilon: CBF constraint slack, not the TCP tracking error
notation.r_k: linearization residual constant containing the reference; not a standalone measured target position
notation.L_Bk: base kinematic/pose-error Jacobians composed with condensed base dynamics
notation.L_ak: arm kinematic Jacobian composed with arm setpoint-model prediction

scope: World/control-environment-frame TCP task during grasping. Relative-base carry can have L_B=0.
costs_and_constraints: Diagram expands cost dependence only; CBF rows couple base prediction and slack through constraints.
processing: Native vector mathematical schematic; no image generation, simulation, training, or QP solve.
